arguments.command:
for f in src/module_*.py; do
  sed -i -E 's/bad_[0-9]+:.*=.*/bad_0: int = 0/' $f
  sed -i -E 's/items_[0-9]+:.*=.*/items_43: list[int] = [1]/' $f
  sed -i -E 's/flag_[0-9]+:.*=.*/flag_86: bool = False/' $f
  sed -i -E 's/name_[0-9]+:.*=.*/name_129: str = ""/' $f
  sed -i -E 's/count_[0-9]+:.*=.*/count_172: int = 3/' $f
  sed -i -E 's/mapping_[0-9]+:.*=.*/mapping_215: dict[str,int] = {"x":1}/' $f
 done

cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run mypy on all src/ Python files
./bin/mypy src
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "Mypy check failed. Aborting commit."
  exit 1
fi
EOF
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
